Work With Us

At Hippocrates Wellness, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer purpose-driven careers rooted in wellness, innovation, and human potential.

For over 70 years, our campus has been a sanctuary where individuals from around the world come to radically transform their health and their lives. Our team is made up of passionate, mission-driven individuals who believe in the power of natural healing, conscious living, and creating a more vibrant, sustainable future.

When you join Hippocrates, you become part of something bigger:

  • A global movement for integrative wellness
  • A community that supports personal and professional growth
  • A culture that values innovation, compassion, and authenticity

Whether you’re working directly with guests or behind the scenes, your role contributes to an environment where the immune system can thrive, where minds can reset, and where lives can be reimagined.

We’re looking for individuals who are:

  • Purpose-led and people-centered
  • Energized by health, healing, and holistic living
  • Committed to excellence, service, and growth

Working at Hippocrates Wellness can be both demanding and deeply fulfilling. Our fast-paced environment requires adaptability, commitment, and a high level of personal accountability — we’re supporting people through life-changing transformations, and that calls for presence and precision. But the reward is extraordinary: every day, you witness lives being renewed, contribute to a mission that matters, and grow alongside a team driven by purpose, compassion, and innovation. It’s more than a job — it’s a calling.

Available Roles

Maintenance Technician

This is a fulltime hourly position.

POSITION: Complete repairs, assist with general and preventative maintenance and complete maintenance projects to maintain the Hippocrates Property. Be part of the team completing preventive maintenance and improvements on campus.

Essential job functions:

Troubleshooting and repairing malfunctions in electrical/mechanical/plumbing systems (e.g. HVAC, boilers, fire systems, refrigeration systems, lighting, appliances & other resort equipment).

Assist with ongoing structure and property preventative maintenance; carpentry work, painting, power washing etc.

Assist with all building repairs and remodeling and repair broken furniture when possible. Interior and exterior work required.

Ensure pools are properly maintained to include cleanliness.

Assist landscaping team as needed.

Answer service calls and work orders, and quickly respond to any maintenance requests.

Making sure that interior and exterior of all buildings are properly maintained.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

Strong working knowledge of Plumbing, Carpentry, Electrical, Construction, and Facilities Maintenance.

Carpentry and painting skills, as well as drywall.

Previous experience in maintenance/engineering specific to electrical, plumbing, HVAC system, ventilation system and carpentry.

Strong working knowledge of Plumbing, Carpentry, Electrical, Construction, and Facilities Maintenance.

Working knowledge and experience with swimming pool maintenance. Experience ordering supplies and inventory.

Pool maintenance experience - preferred

Must be able to communicate effectively verbally and in writing with guests and staff.

Bilingual English/Spanish - preferred

Prior hotel maintenance experience is a plus.

*** We are open 365 days a year. Must be flexible and able to work some weekends and holidays ***

Pssst...If you've read this far and want to stand out from the majority of candidates: Be sure to tell us very clearly whether you're vegan and where you are in your vegan journey, why you want to work with us, AND be sure to complete any assessments, so that your application is not left incomplete. : -)

Quick tips about the HHI Campus: We are a scent free environment, so that means no perfumed lotions, deodorants or soaps. Please no smoking or drinking of alcoholic beverages. Please do not bring any food or drink on campus that is not vegan.
